comparison.objective: Dispense exactly ten pre-counted tablets from a tray into a held vial.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual granular pouring while separating counted tablets from extras.
comparison.success_condition: All ten intended tablets enter the raised vial, extras remain, and none spill.
comparison.reason: This is selective granular transfer and spill control, with no threaded setting, locking reaction, or functional retention test.
